title: What's New: Server and Database (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Net Formats for Numbers
features.description: New way to format numbers in auto format expressions allowing custom formatting based on positive, negative or zero values.
caveats: Only works in auto format expressions, not in the format function

features.name: Get URL AL Function with Layout Parameter
features.description: Two new overloads of the get URL AL function to construct URLs that use the layout parameter for opening pages in different modes such as analysis mode.

features.name: Calculate Only Visible Flow Fields
features.description: Performance feature to specify calculating only visible flow fields on a page, enabled via feature management key initially before becoming default.
caveats: Requires feature management key to enable
Will become default in future release

features.name: Set AutoCalc Fields Method
features.description: New method on record ref to call set autoc calc fields which sets which flow fields should be updated automatically.

features.name: Session Information Stack Property
features.description: New property session information.stack to capture the current stack trace from AL code.
caveats: Use sparingly as it requires significant CPU
Performance impact if overused

features.name: Telemetry Custom Dimensions User Type and Guest User
features.description: Two new custom dimensions user type and guest user added to telemetry events RT2 and RT4, previously required expensive joining of events RT1 and RT3.

features.name: Faster Copy Company
features.description: Copy company operation is now up to five times faster especially when dealing with large amounts of data.
caveats: Can take significant locks
Do not run during working hours
Requires substantial database resources

features.name: Database Missing Indexes Page Enhancements
features.description: New fields added to database missing indexes page including seeks, scans, average total cost, average impact, and estimated benefit to help evaluate proposed index usefulness.

features.name: Enable SQL Multi-Subnet Failover Option
features.description: New server setting for on-premises installations to enable SQL multi-subnet failover, improving failover time by adding new properties to connection strings.
caveats: On-premises only
Requires SQL Server multi-subnet failover setup

features.name: HTTP Server Certificate Validation
features.description: Security hardening from Microsoft Secure Future Initiative that validates server certificates on outgoing HTTP client calls, blocking endpoints with invalid certificates.
caveats: Can be disabled in version 26 via feature management key
Will be enforced without option to disable in October 2025
May block endpoints with invalid certificates

features.name: Block UI Pages as SOAP Endpoints
features.description: Microsoft-owned UI pages are now blocked from being published as SOAP endpoints starting in this wave, with optional disabling via feature management.
caveats: Can be disabled via feature management
Microsoft-owned pages only blocked
Per-tenant extensions can still expose pages
Blocking will be enforced in a later release wave

features.name: PDF Post-Processing in Reports
features.description: New on pre-rendering report trigger allowing appending PDF documents, embedding documents inside PDFs, and setting admin or user passwords for PDF documents.

features.name: Report Metadata in Word Layouts
features.description: Two new types of metadata in XML embedded in word layouts: report metadata and report requests, including report name, metadata, user, company and rendering time.

features.name: Excel Multiple Worksheet Property Override
features.description: Ability to override the report default for the Excel multiple worksheet property in both AL and user-provided uploaded layouts for non-breaking changes.
caveats: Enables non-breaking changes when layouts assume certain values

features.name: Layout Obsolescence Support
features.description: Ability to obsolete a report layout using obsolete tags in AL or through uploaded layouts shown on the report layouts page.

features.name: Report Layouts Page Enhancements
features.description: New properties on report layouts page including show deprecated or obsolete, last modified by, when last modified, and new get info action for troubleshooting.

features.name: Layout Validation Action
features.description: New validate action on report layouts page to validate whether layouts are okay, with font validation for RDL layouts and plans for Word and Excel in future updates.
caveats: Font validation in version 26 for RDL layouts only
Word and Excel font validation coming in later minor update
